title: Gate 5: three architecture branches tested against their own controls, three killed
rule: A branch survives only if it adds an independent capability or Pareto improvement beyond the frozen adaptive-halting core.

branch_A_complex_fields.design: Genuinely complex state carried as complex64, Hermitian attention so phase affects the halting decision, matched REAL parameter count (56545 against the real model's 55001).
branch_A_complex_fields.control: The real model on the identical task: 1.0000 accuracy, 6.14 mean steps.
branch_A_complex_fields.verdict: KILLED. Identical accuracy, identical halting, identical depth, at matched real parameters. The complex field changes nothing.
branch_A_complex_fields.consistency: Consistent with FAIL-005 and the exact-realification result: expressivity was already known to be identical, and the remaining route -- optimisation dynamics -- is now measured and also identical.

branch_B_adaptive_width.design: C(x) = T(x) * N(x). The step MLP's hidden layer is split into 8 groups; a per-step router keeps the top k. Straight-through hard masking. Compared against the SAME number of hidden units chosen statically at construction.
branch_B_adaptive_width.verdict: KILLED by its own control, at both capacity regimes. A statically narrow model matches the routed one at identical cost with 43% fewer parameters, and beats it at the aggressive setting (static 2/8 reaches 1.0000 at cost 1.54 where routed 2/8 reaches 0.8143 at cost 2.13). At binding capacity routing is strictly worse than static narrowing.
branch_B_adaptive_width.accounting_bug_found_and_fixed: The first version charged fixed-depth models only up to their SELECTED step rather than the full depth they execute, understating their cost by 4x and briefly making routing look like a 2x Pareto win. Corrected before any conclusion was drawn.

branches_not_attempted.C_homeostatic_control: Partially addressed and deprioritised. RMS normalisation is already a homeostatic mechanism and already took seed reliability from 11-of-24 to 20-of-20, so a learned controller has no measurable headroom left on the surviving family. Hyperparameter sensitivity is measured separately under Gate 7.
branches_not_attempted.D_self_repair: Not attempted. Requires a capability the surviving core does not have -- there is no redundant substrate to repair into -- and the mechanism it would defend has just been restricted by QNEURO3-HAR-P1.
branches_not_attempted.E_developmental_specialisation: Not attempted. Branch B already measured that per-example routing over hidden groups is beaten by static narrowing, which is the same question one level down.
branches_not_attempted.F_distillation: Not attempted as a Q-Neuro mechanism, but it appears in the programme as PRIOR ART: the HAR supervised arm derives its halt target by distilling a teacher's earliest confident-correct chunk, and that arm lost.
branches_not_attempted.honesty: These are recorded as NOT DONE with reasons, not as negative results.
